findings.defect: The Korean cautions against trying to understand it rashly or prematurely, not against trying to understand it at all. “Don’t bother” removes that temporal qualification and makes the prohibition stronger.
findings.rationale: 섣부르게 means rashly/prematurely; the line permits understanding later while warning against a premature attempt.
findings.replacement: Don’t try to understand it too hastily.

summary: The chapter is substantially faithful. One minor modality shift remains in Jeok Cheongang’s explanation of the Heavenly Martial Physique.
